reasoning: Shows a rectangular screen or tablet frame enclosing a gear, clearly representing system settings, display preferences, or device configuration. It fits tech, home device, and admin setup tasks well, though at tiny sizes the frame around the cog can faintly resemble a point-and-shoot camera or wall safe.

pass1.ambiguity: Could be mistaken for a wall safe, a camera body from the front, or a generic plain gear icon at very small sizes.
